With this release, Kazakhstan became the first country to restore its tiger range after they had been thought extinct, with the last reliable sighting in the country recorded more than 70 years ago.

Umit – a wild-caught female tiger transported from the Russian far east – will be joined by more big cats in the coming years, with plans to establish a self-sustaining population of about 50. A wild-caught male flown from Russia is still being monitored by authorities and will be released when he is judged fit to survive alone. There’s only one solution in the end to the drought now declared across most of England and that’s rain, says Hannah Cloke, professor of hydrology at the University of Reading.

An important consequence of drought is that very dry soils can become less able to absorb rainfall when it does arrive. This can increase surface runoff and can even contribute to localised flash flooding, particularly if rain falls intensely over a short period.

events.summary: A powerful 7.4 magnitude earthquake wreaked havoc in Colombia early this morning. Homes and buildings were reduced to rubble as people ran for safety. Tonight rescue teams are urgently removing debris and searching for survivors. NBC News’ George Solis reports.

events.title: Death toll in earthquake surpasses 100, Colombian president says
events.summary: Colombian President Abelardo De La Espriella said the death toll rose to 111 in the 7.4-magnitude earthquake that hit the country about 250 miles west of its capital of Bogota. NBC News’ George Solis reports on connectivity issues throughout the country and the extensive clean-up effort ahead.

events.title: Watch: Videos capture the moment a 7.4-magnitude earthquake strikes Colombia
events.summary: Watch videos captured from Colombia as a 7.4-magnitude earthquake struck the country. Casualties have been reported with many still missing amid the collapsed buildings and debris.

events.title: ‘A piece of our history’: Untouched Roman shipwreck discovered off Italy
events.summary: Divers have uncovered a Roman-era shipwreck that had remained untouched on the seabed off Sicily for more than 2,000 years, police on the Mediterranean island said.

events.title: Israel rejects Trump’s 15-point plan for Gaza

events.title: Video shows hippo charging boat full of tourists in Botswana
events.summary: Video captured by a tourist aboard a boat in northern Botswana showed the heart-pounding moment the vessel had to outrun a charging hippo.

events.title: Student kills multiple people at Thai school after fatally shooting grandparents
events.summary: At least one teacher was killed and four other people injured by a student who opened fire at a school in Thailand on Friday before killing himself, authorities said.
